name: Wilfried Knight
summary: Wilfried Knight (19 February 1975 – 5 March 2013) was a French gay pornographic film actor and model. Born in Châlons-sur-Marne, France, he later worked primarily in the United States and appeared in productions for several major studios in the gay adult film industry.
